For [formats](/docs/shell/commands/categories/formats/).

<div class='command-title'>Parse url-encoded string as a record.</div>

## Command Type

`built-in`

## Signature

```> from url {flags} ```


## Input/output types:

| input  | output |
| ------ | ------ |
| string | record |
## Examples

Convert url encoded string into a record
```nu
> 'bread=baguette&cheese=comt%C3%A9&meat=ham&fat=butter' | from url
╭────────┬──────────╮
│ bread  │ baguette │
│ cheese │ comté    │
│ meat   │ ham      │
│ fat    │ butter   │
╰────────┴──────────╯
```
